description: HAR file analyzer — Analyze a browser HAR (HTTP Archive) capture from DevTools/Playwright: requests, transfer bytes, wall time, timing totals, breakdown by status, resource type, protocol and domain (first vs third party), slowest and largest requests, errors, and a graded issue list (failed requests, 5xx/4xx, plain-HTTP, slow TTFB, uncompressed text, large images/scripts, static assets without caching, redirects, duplicate requests, HTTP/1.x, many third parties). Detects credentials in the capture (Authorization, cookies, API-key headers, tokens in URLs) and reports counts only, with secret query values redacted. Input har= (HAR JSON text) or url= (.har link, max 5 MB; first 3000 entries analyzed). Optional top= (default 10), slow_ms= (TTFB threshold, default 800), first_party= (domain). Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_har_analyze
